name: Do I need to be home during the roof installation?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to be home during the roof installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it's not strictly necessary for you to be home for the entire duration of the roof installation, we recommend being available for the initial consultation and any specific questions that may arise during the project. Our team handles the work externally, and we ensure minimal disruption to your daily routine. We will establish clear communication channels so you can be updated on progress and address any concerns without needing constant supervision on-site.
acceptedAnswer.description: You don't need to be home for the entire installation, but being available for initial discussions and questions is helpful. Our team ensures communication and minimal disruption.
